In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a market oriented management system, with a strong focus on market connection and market oriented value chains, is the key to profitability in fishing.

the Icelandic fisheries management system has been a success, but that the success of the Icelandic fisheries management has been facilitated by the development of a strong market structure and a strong connection to consumer demand.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Icelandic fisheries management system has been successful at ensuring long run profitability in the fishing sector.
the development of a market oriented fishing industry requires a market oriented management system.

the Icelandic fishing and fish processing industry have been able to develop a profitable value chain, in spite of the challenges of the Icelandic environment, due to the combination of a strong market focus in the processing industry, the development of a market oriented fish auction system and the introduction of individual transferable quota system for fishing rights.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the development of a market oriented value chain requires the development of a strong market connection between fishers and consumers.
the Icelandic demersals industry has been able to maintain a strong market position through its ability to adapt to changing consumer preferences and to supply the market with a consistent product.
the market system is a critical component of fisheries management, and must be addressed in conjunction with other components of management.
